OEM should have a 24x7 Toll-Free Helpdesk number (with human call center executive support, IVR Suppo rt at night shall not be accepted) operational in a minimum of two languages Hindi & English. The list of service centres should be visible on the OEM website and OEM to pr ovide the link of the same. 3. OEM declaration regarding the features to be uploaded along with the Bid. 5. Any further training is to be provided by the bidder/OEM a s per the requirement of the buyer. Additional Term and Condition.
